verdict.rationale: Poly holds the user's own files in their native formats. Its desktop app exposes them as a real Finder/Explorer folder with on-demand download, and journal entries are stored as Markdown files in the Mind folder, so the content stays reachable in open formats outside Poly. However, no dedicated bulk export or 'download everything' feature is documented. It is also unclear whether derived data such as Poly's memory, tags and indexes can be exported. missing for 10: a documented full-account export feature, export of Mind memory and metadata in open formats, confirmation that the whole library can be downloaded offline at once, independent hands-on corroboration of leaving Poly.
